description: Ability to set the object owner; owner implicitly gains WriteDacl, chaining to full control.

telemetry.detail: Owner (nTSecurityDescriptor owner field) change logged under DS-change auditing.
Object permissions/owner changed - requires object SACL auditing.
Ownership takeover of a privileged object is a rare, high-signal action once directory-change modelling is in place.

abuse_primitive: Set self as owner -> WriteDacl -> grant control -> abuse. Multi-step chain.
notes: Comparable to WriteDacl. Loud only where directory-change auditing is enabled; otherwise the follow-on abuse is the visible part.
